chunks: 1167 - And Muḥammad ibn Muslim narrated from one of the two of them, peace be upon them:
Regarding a man who enters the mosque and fears that the rak'ah will escape him.
He said: "He should perform ruku' before he reaches the people, and walk while he is bowing until he reaches them."

key_terms.الرَّكْعَةُ: a unit of prayer whose timely attainment is being feared
key_terms.الْقَوْمِ: the congregation or group praying together
key_terms.الْمَسْجِدَ: the mosque, where the congregational salat is being performed
key_terms.رَاكِعٌ: being in the state of bowing during salat
key_terms.يَرْكَعُ: he performs ruku', the bowing posture in salat

ai.seo_question: What should a person do if he enters the mosque and fears missing the rak'ah in congregational prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about one who enters the mosque and fears missing the rak'ah in congregational salat. It permits him to go into ruku' before fully reaching the row and then move forward while bowing until he joins the congregation.
